title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Products & Services
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Graduate Analyst Programme

Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.

You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.

If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.

We're looking for Graduate Analysts to join our Products & Services practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.

The business units currently hiring are:

title: Member Care Advocate (MCA) - November Cohort
description:
Included Health is on a mission to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. We simplify healthcare by combining virtual and in-person care with expert navigation, comprehensive support, and technology that makes it easier for members to get the right care at the right time.
Our Member Care Advocates (MCAs) are some of the most visible representatives of this mission, helping members feel seen, supported, and confident in navigating their benefits and care options. MCAs are a trusted guide, helping members navigate the fundamentals of their healthcare benefits while delivering high-quality, empathetic support in a high-volume environment. This role requires strong critical thinking and ownership to navigate member needs effectively.
New MCA hires start their role in an 3-week paid training period with a strict schedule of 10 a.m. - 7 p.m. EST, Monday - Friday. Upon completion of the 3-week training period, employees will transition to their regular schedule as outlined during their offer and onboarding process. This is a remote position and requires a secure, distraction-free home office.

• Exceptional customer service skills, with the ability to act as a member advocate, de-escalate challenging situations, and maintain a professional, friendly demeanor.

• Strong verbal communication skills for phone interactions, including the ability to explain benefits, processes, and next steps clearly and confidently.

• Strong written communication skills in English for accurate, clear documentation of member interactions.

• Comfortable gathering information, asking clarifying questions, and structuring a clear summary when additional follow-up by other teams is needed.

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

In this role, you will be building the recruitment operations and coordination engine that accelerates our global talent acquisition efforts, which is critical for scaling our world-class team to solve humanity's hardest materials science challenges.

- Conduct periodic audits of ATS data integrity and ensure compliance with global data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR).

- Coordinate candidate travel logistics, expense reimbursements, and virtual or onsite interview setups.

Interdisciplinary & Stakeholder Collaboration

title: Senior Software Release Technical Program Manager, Hyperscale Line of Business
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

You will be the pivotal, end-to-end owner driving the product lifecycle for our cutting-edge data center storage solutions. Your mission is to translate product vision into Mass Production (MP) reality, managing all aspects of the hardware (Mechanical and Electrical Engineering) and the full software stack (firmware, OS). This highly visible role requires you to orchestrate global, cross-functional engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams while leading executive-level phase gate reviews to ensure our products deliver optimal performance and compliance, on time and on budget.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• End-to-End Release Ownership: Own the overall release plan, including scope, milestones, and dependencies. You’ll be the primary point of contact for release lines across Product, Engineering, QA, and Security.

• Strategic Program Leadership: Manage multiple concurrent workstreams involving cross-functional stakeholders. You will own the "big picture," ensuring that high-level technical architecture aligns with execution.

• Release Integrity: Own release branch health metrics. You’ll lead bug scrubs, triage critical issues, and define the criteria for merging new payloads (leveraging your experience with Git-based workflows).

• Operational Excellence: Drive the Product Lifecycle (PLC) phase exit reviews (Phases 0-3). You will define exit criteria, ensure they are met, and formally drive approvals.

• Risk & Conflict Resolution: Identify critical paths, bottlenecks, and risks early. You’ll facilitate technical decision-making and resolve conflicts across team boundaries to keep the engine moving.

• Financial & Resource Stewardship: Responsible for Capex planning. You will ensure spend is within bounds through accurate monthly, quarterly, and yearly accounting.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead post-release retrospectives. You aren’t just looking for what went wrong; you’re a change agent identifying process optimizations to accelerate time-to-market.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Deep Technical Program Management: Expert ability to manage the full, complex, end-to-end product development for hardware systems, spanning both Mechanical/Electrical Engineering and the integrated software/firmware stack.

• NPI/Product Lifecycle Expertise: Proven track record of successfully guiding products through New Product Introduction (NPI) phases, specifically managing EVT, DVT, PVT, and MP in a high-tech/data center environment.

• Executive Communication & Influence: Exceptional ability to synthesize and communicate complex program information and business strategy to executive leadership, effectively leading decision-making reviews.

• Financial Acumen & Business Strategy: Demonstrated skill in program budget management, product cost analysis, and using financial data to influence strategic program direction and scope.

title: Builder
description:
About SafeLease

At SafeLease , we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems - they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.
SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk - we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.
We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.
Why "Builder"?
The best people on our team start with a business problem, figure out what should exist to solve it, and then build it, often end-to-end. They talk to stakeholders, sketch out solutions, make product and design decisions, write the code, and ship it. They use AI tools not as a novelty but as a core part of how they work. The line between "product thinking" and "engineering" isn't one they spend much time drawing.
We call this role Builder because that's what it actually is. You'll work in small pods with a GM who sets direction, but how you get there and what you build along the way is largely up to you.
If you're looking for a well-defined backlog and a narrow lane, this probably isn't the right fit. If you want the autonomy to solve real problems and the context to understand why they matter, keep reading.
About the Role
To drive our mission forward, this role will:

• Start with the problem, not the ticket. Understand the business context behind what you're building. Know why it matters to customers, to the business, and to the team.

• Own outcomes, not just output. Take features from idea to production. That means participating in product and design decisions, not waiting for a spec to land in your lap.

• Build across the full stack. Write clean, maintainable code across frontend, backend, and infrastructure with a focus on reliability, performance, and simplicity.

title: Senior Manager, Royalty Administration & Onboarding
description:
Established in 2015, Create Music Group is a leading music and entertainment company. The company operates as a record label, distribution company, and entertainment network which generates over 15 billion music streams each month on DSP’s. Named #2 on the Inc 5000 Fastest Growth Companies in America in 2020, the company has grown exponentially by leveraging its owned IP with its media and technology platform. The company works with superstar artists, major and independent record labels, and global media brands. It operates a number of companies including Label Engine, one of the largest independent music distribution platforms in the world, with over 75,000 artists and 5,000 label clients; and Flighthouse, a digital entertainment brand focused on Gen Z, which has more than 300 million followers across social media. Create Music Group is based in Hollywood, CA and has 400 employees worldwide.

Job Summary

At Create Music Group , acquiring a catalog is only the beginning. The next step is turning each acquisition into a fully operational royalty business - accurately configured, scalable, and built to serve artists, partners, and rightsholders for the long term.

The Senior Manager, Royalty Administration & Onboarding plays a critical role in making that happen. This leader oversees the royalty onboarding strategy for newly acquired catalogs, translating complex deal terms into clear, effective royalty structures and workflows across Create’s systems. From interpreting acquisition agreements to designing the future-state setup, this role ensures every catalog is positioned for accurate and efficient royalty administration from day one.

As a key partner to our M&A, Finance, Legal, and Royalties teams, the Senior Manager is involved early in the acquisition lifecycle-including during diligence-to identify royalty requirements, surface potential gaps, and help shape a seamless transition into Create’s platform. The role works closely with the Director of Royalties and leads a growing team responsible for bringing each onboarding strategy to life.

This is an opportunity to sit at the intersection of music rights, acquisitions, operations, and technology at a company that continues to expand its global catalog and platform. We’re looking for a leader who understands the details of royalty administration but can also see the bigger picture: how to build scalable processes, navigate complex deals, and create an exceptional foundation for every catalog that joins Create Music Group .

Responsibilities

• Own contract-to-system royalty interpretation company-wide: rates, splits, territories, escalators, cross-collateralization, recoupment, and defensible workarounds where a platform cannot implement a term literally.

• Own the Royalties Readiness Gate for incoming acquisitions. Issue the go/no-go recommendation on every acquisition before it enters statement processing, with peer review from the Senior Manager, Royalty Accounting & Operations.

• Own the handoff packet standard for incoming acquisitions. Every acquisition handoff states plainly what is final, what is assumed, and what remains open. No acquisition transfers to operations without one.

• Lead contractual royalty obligation analysis for acquisitions, including a written risk/reward recommendation on onboarding methodology - migrate the label into our systems, or leave it on its existing platform.

• Represent Royalties in M&A diligence from LOI. Own the royalty section of the diligence memo and the list of closing conditions Royalties depends on.

• Own the team's project portfolio: expense validation tooling, bulk and automated ingestion of expenses, sales, and contracts, the M&A onboarding checklist, and automated metadata, contract, and payor template generation derived from statement analysis.

• Own role-based access and configuration governance across all royalty systems. Define who may create clients, update splits, and alter contract terms - and enforce it.

Job Summary:
At the Center for Education Policy Research at Harvard University (CEPR) our mission is to transform education through the power of quality evidence. We believe that if we want to dramatically improve educational outcomes for all children, evidence must play a critical role.
The Math Teaching and Teacher Learning team at CEPR provides math-specific professional development to teachers and coaches to help improve math instruction. Our current grant-funded projects seek to develop and test an expanded math-specific coach training program (M-Powering Teacher Coaching) that uses machine-learning automated feedback and AI-enhanced coaching tools. The Data Scientist will contribute to this and other projects that connect rigorous educational research with practical tools for teachers, instructional coaches, and education leaders. This person will oversee, manage, and lead analysis and application of complex datasets, and contribute to the integration of research insights into innovative educational tools and cutting-edge products. They will be joining a team with faculty lead and Principal Investigator, Heather Hill, and collaborators at higher education research institutions, professional learning organizations, curriculum providers, and Enterprise AI firm(s).

Data and Research Infrastructure:

• Organizes, cleans, and prepares structured and unstructured data (e.g., video, audio, text) for AI modeling and analysis.

• Develops and documents codebooks, annotation protocols, data dictionaries, and other research procedures.

• Builds and documents reproducible workflows for data processing, annotation, statistical analysis, and modeling.

• Supports shared practices for version control, code review, data security, and reproducible research.

• Maintains organized project files, code repositories, data documentation, and analytic records.

Analysis and Measurement Development

• Conduct data science work across grant-funded projects focused on teaching, instructional coaching, curriculum, and artificial intelligence in education.

• Applies statistical, machine learning, natural language processing, and generative AI methods as appropriate.

• Coordinates and executes the development and evaluation of automated measures related to teaching, coaching, curriculum implementation, and teacher learning.

• Supports pilot studies and evaluation activities related to usability, implementation, coaching, and teacher experience.

Product Development and Dissemination

• Helps integrate research measures and findings into education tools and user interfaces.

• Contributes to research papers, reports, public goods, funder deliverables, and other project materials (e.g., tables, figures, visualization, presentations, and technical documentation)

Project Management and Cross-team Collaboration

• Manages timelines and deliverables across one or more grant-funded workstreams

• Collaborates with researchers, educators, software developers, and external partners such as Enterprise AI firm(s) to support project goals.

• Oversees internal working groups to deliver on tasks and milestones

Performs other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Education, Social Science, or a related field.

• Must have strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

• Occasional travel may be required to support project meetings, trainings, pilot activities, or other research-related events.

description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .

We're hiring a Manager, GRC to join our Technology Risk & Controls team within Security and lead second line of defense advisory coverage across critical technology and security domains. This team evaluates risk posture, improves control design, and helps engineering, infrastructure, and security leaders make better, risk-informed decisions. You'll both manage a team and directly own advisory coverage for domains that may include disaster recovery and resiliency, SDLC, artificial intelligence, identity and access management, and supply chain - building trusted partnerships that ensure Coinbase addresses its most critical risks in its most critical functions.
What you'll do:

• Lead second line advisory coverage for key technology and security domains, assessing risk exposure, control effectiveness, policy alignment, and emerging issues across the business.

• Partner with engineering and technology teams to evaluate domain posture and identify where additional controls, remediation, or governance improvements are needed.

• Review and challenge the design of new and existing risks and their corresponding controls to ensure our mitigations are scalable, effective, and aligned to business, risk, and regulatory expectations.

• Drive coordination across risk, controls, policy, audit, and assurance teams to translate incidents, audit findings, and regulatory expectations into actionable improvements that strengthen the technology control environment.

• Intake, triage, and calculate inherent and residual risk with subject matter experts and risk owners, facilitating risk treatment decisions and validating execution of mitigation plans.

• Enable leadership decision-making by communicating quantitative and qualitative risk tradeoffs and connecting risks, controls, policies, incidents, and findings into clear narratives that support prioritization and reporting.

• Build, grow, and coach a team of technology and security analysts and senior analysts, fostering a culture of agility, innovation, and continuous performance feedback.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 8+ years in technology risk, IT controls, IT audit, cybersecurity risk, or compliance, with hands-on experience delivering full-stack GRC services (risk management, control design, continuous monitoring, governance documentation) - not a controls-only or risk-only background.

• Deep understanding of technical design and governance principles across one or more domains such as infrastructure resiliency, SDLC, change management, or incident response, with demonstrated ability to challenge status quo and drive improvement.

• Hands-on experience evaluating risks and control design, identifying weaknesses, and partnering with stakeholders to improve risk outcomes and control maturity.

• Proven track record managing and mentoring analysts, growing their capabilities and careers while holding teams accountable to deliverables and timelines.

• Track record of influencing cross-functional stakeholders, navigating ambiguity, and translating complex risk and compliance concepts into clear functional requirements for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two.

• Build strong relationships with business leaders, product owners, and cross-functional teams

• Facilitate workshops, requirements sessions, stakeholder interviews, and decision-making discussions

• Act as a trusted liaison between business and technology teams, ensuring alignment throughout the project lifecycle

• Communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

• Support initiatives involving data platforms, analytics solutions, business intelligence, customer insights, and cloud-based technologies

• Collaborate with technical teams to define data requirements, business rules, and reporting needs

• Analyze data and business processes to identify opportunities for optimization and enhanced decision-making

• Help ensure data quality, validation, and consistency throughout project delivery

• Work closely with Agile teams to refine backlogs, prioritize requirements, and support sprint planning activities

• Collaborate with Product Owners to define and manage work priorities based on business value and outcomes

• Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

• Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities and validate that delivered solutions meet business requirements

THE OPPORTUNITY

Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.

More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.

For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.

This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.

We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.

WHAT YOU WILL BUILD AND LEAD

As Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. 

Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:

- access to care, search and booking;

- patient messaging and teleconsultation;

- the Patient Health Record and patient context;

- the app homepage and daily health experience;

- health content and prevention;

- recommendations, reminders and care plans;

- new patient services and subscription experiences;

- conversational and AI-powered experiences.

The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.

- Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.

- Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.

- Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.

- Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.

- Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.

- Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.

- Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.

- Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.

- Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first year, you will have:

- established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;

- raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;

- helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;

- strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;

- developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;

- helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.

About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution” headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting www.vensure.com.
Position Summary The Senior Global HR Specialist supports the delivery of internal human resources services for employees throughout Europe and for international employees engaged through Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements and contingent worker vendor relationships. The position coordinates employee lifecycle activities, HR documentation, employee relations support, payroll and benefits administration, immigration processes, HR systems, and compliance activities in alignment with approved corporate standards and applicable local requirements. The role independently manages routine matters, partners with internal and external stakeholders, and escalates complex employee relations, disciplinary, policy, and compliance matters to HR leadership.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
• Coordinate day-to-day HR operations for European business units and international EOR and contingent worker populations in line with approved processes and local requirements.
• Serve as an operational contact for employees, managers, EOR providers, contingent worker vendors, and internal partners; respond to routine inquiries and escalate complex or high-risk matters.
• Support onboarding, employee changes, leave coordination, and offboarding; ensure documentation, approvals, system updates, and notifications are completed accurately and on time.
• Prepare, review, route, and maintain employment contracts, amendments, employee letters, and related HR documentation using approved templates and guidance.
• Coordinate EOR employee administration including onboarding, benefits, payroll inputs, contractual documentation, and issue resolution with local providers.
• Support employee relations by gathering facts, maintaining case documentation, communicating approved guidance, and escalating complex disciplinary, compliance, or policy issues.
• Coordinate immigration and work-authorization activities; collect and track documents and liaise with employees, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
• Assist payroll and benefits administration by validating employee data, coordinating changes with paymasters and vendors, supporting enrollment, and resolving discrepancies.
• Maintain timely and accurate employee records, case notes, personnel files, compliance documentation, and HRIS data; audit system changes and profiles before payroll processing.
• Monitor and resolve Recruiting and HR tickets and cases for supported business units within service expectations.
• Research regulatory developments, local employment practices, labor market information, and HR requirements; summarize findings and support implementation of approved policy/process updates.
• Collaborate with Payroll, Benefits, Recruiting, IT, Legal, Compliance, HR Integration, and other teams to coordinate lifecycle activities and resolve operational issues.
• Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, project updates, employee data summaries, and compliance documentation for HR leadership.
• Support HR service-delivery and process-improvement initiatives by documenting workflows, identifying recurring issues, participating in testing, and recommending improvements.
• Build and maintain productive relationships with external vendors and internal stakeholders to support consistent service delivery across countries and cultures.

title: Senior Project Manager - Government
description:
The Senior Project Manager independently manages strategic technology projects and may serve as a Project Manager within a broader program. Projects are typically high in complexity, risk, or visibility and may involve emerging or highly customized technologies, multiple solution areas, complex systems integration, and third-party vendors. The Senior Project Manager owns all aspects of project delivery, from initiation through closure, and works closely with sales, consultants, clients, subcontractors, and cross-functional delivery teams. This role is accountable for project scope, schedule, financial performance, contractual commitments, risk management, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction. The Senior Project Manager may provide guidance and mentorship to other project team members. The role acts as a project advocate, driving results, making difficult decisions, and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
What You Will Do

• Successfully executes projects using CDW -G’s established delivery methodology, adapting the approach where appropriate to meet the needs of each engagement. Manages projects that may span multiple solution areas, service areas, workstreams, technologies, and third-party providers. Ensures the client’s business, technical, contractual, and operational requirements are understood and met.

• Ensures project time, expenses, invoices, and financial records are accurately tracked, reviewed, and approved in a timely manner. Identifies financial risks and works with project stakeholders to mitigate their impact.

• Understands the financial implications of project decisions and changes, including their potential effect on the client relationship, contractual commitments, and CDW -G profitability.

• Validates initial project scope, assumptions, estimates, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Evaluates proposed changes for their impact on scope, schedule, cost, resources, risk, contractual commitments, and client outcomes. Develops recommendations and initiates the appropriate change-control actions.

• Establishes strategies to minimize client and project impact resulting from approved or anticipated changes. Communicates impacts and recommendations to the appropriate stakeholders.

• Ensures all items defined in the CDW Statement of Work are delivered and performs quality assurance throughout the project life cycle.

• Proactively identifies, analyzes, documents, and manages project risks, issues, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies. Develops mitigation and contingency plans and communicates exposure, ownership, and required decisions to stakeholders.

• Proactively conducts resource planning across project workstreams. Monitors and adjusts assignments, capacity, and billable schedules as necessary. Resolves resource and scheduling conflicts and escalates constraints that could affect project delivery.

• Develops, maintains, and communicates integrated project schedules in collaboration with engineering teams, client teams, subcontractors, and third-party vendors. Aligns project dependencies, milestones, contractual dates, and resource commitments.

They will work with interdisciplinary teams to identify, compile, and research promising water policy interventions, develop legislative or administrative solutions for those interventions, and work with government relations professionals and others to implement those solutions at the state or federal level. title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About HeyMax

HeyMax turns everyday spending into travel. Users earn Max Miles on the things they already buy, and redeem them for flights, hotels, and experiences worldwide. Founded in 2023, we're live in Singapore and Hong Kong - and building toward a product that works for anyone, anywhere in the world.
The role - a mini lab inside HeyMax

You'll run a growth and expansion design lab: a small, autonomous unit with one mandate - grow HeyMax 's user base, anywhere in the world. That means the full growth surface: how new users discover and activate, how existing users deepen and refer, and how the experience flexes for markets and users we haven't designed for yet. You operate like a startup within the startup - pick the highest-leverage problem, ship an experiment, read the data, decide what's next.
What you'll own

•
Global activation - the entire journey from first touch to first value moment, designed to work for any user in any market from day one. This is the engine that lets HeyMax launch a country without rebuilding the product.

•
One experience, every market - an adaptive design system where the product reconfigures itself around user state and market maturity. You're not designing screens per country; you're designing the rules that make one product serve a hundred markets.

•
Compounding growth loops - referral, sharing, and re-engagement mechanics built to scale across borders. Every experiment you ship becomes reusable infrastructure for the next market.

•
The lab's playbook - you set the growth agenda, run the experiment portfolio, and build the repeatable expansion playbook the whole company will run on.

Who you are

• 5+ years consumer product design, with real growth work - you've owned an activation or acquisition funnel metric, not just designed alongside one.

• Systems thinker: you design state machines, not screens. "What does this surface look like with 1 partner / 10 partners" is a question you ask before drawing anything.

• AI-native: AI tools are your default for prototyping, research synthesis, and copy variants - you move at lab speed because of it. Bonus: you've designed agent or copilot patterns.

• Comfortable with the ambiguity of a market you can't visit - you design research-cheap ways to learn (fake-door tests, concierge MVPs, remote unmoderated tests).

Role Overview:

This person will partner directly with the Chief Procurement and Commercial Operations Officer (CPCOO) to drive customer contracting strategy and support the full commercial lifecycle from initial engagement through contract execution.
This is a fully remote, individual contributor role that operates with significant autonomy. The person in this role will lead customer contract negotiations, manage NDAs, and complete customer onboarding processes (representing Evolver as vendor to its customers), support RFP/RFI response processes, and provide input to product and engineering teams on Evolver 's procurement products and internally built commercial operations tools. Success requires comfort operating in ambiguity, strong contractual judgment, and the ability to balance commercial objectives against legal and operational risk. Occasional travel for team meetings and customer engagements is expected.
Key Responsibilities:

• Own end-to-end customer contracting, including drafting, redlining, and negotiating customer agreements (MSAs, SOWs, order forms, amendments) from initial terms through execution

• Exercise direct negotiation authority on contract terms, balancing commercial objectives with legal and operational risk

• Negotiate and manage NDAs across prospective customer relationships

• Support customer RFP and RFI processes end-to-end, including coordination across deal teams, response drafting, and submission delivery

A culture that’s fast, flexible, and fiercely entrepreneurial. We move quickly, think creatively, and always put our people first.

title: Solutions Architect, San Francisco
description:
TL;DR - We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to bridge product depth with business outcomes at Lovable. You’ll help customers understand how Lovable fits into their architecture, design solutions that win enterprise trust, and partner with Sales, Product, and Engineering to drive adoption of AI-native software creation.

Please note: this role is located in San Francisco. It is not eligible for remote work. At this time we are unable to support visa sponsorship or transfers.

WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Experience in solutions architecture or sales engineering at a high-growth startup

- Deep understanding of technical architectures, APIs, integrations, data flows, and cloud infrastructure

- Strong consultative selling skills - able to map product capabilities to customer pain points and ROI

- Skilled at communicating complex technical concepts simply to both engineering and executive audiences

- Builder mindset - you enjoy creating scalable processes, proof-of-concepts, and reusable frameworks

- Collaborative partner to Sales, Product, and Engineering, ensuring tight feedback loops

- Bonus: experience with AI platforms, developer tools, or enterprise integrations

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Partner with Sales to lead technical discovery, solution design, and customer evaluation cycles

- Architect Lovable solutions that align with customer goals and technical constraints

- Develop repeatable frameworks for demos, proofs-of-value, and implementation design

- Collaborate with Product and Engineering to influence roadmap priorities and strengthen technical narratives

- Build and maintain technical enablement materials for pre-sales execution

- Serve as Lovable’s technical voice in key enterprise deals, building trust through depth and clarity

About your application

- Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

- We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

title: Solutions Architect - EMEA
description:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. title: Product Engineer / Builder
description:
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy.

More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

Turn what AI can do today into features that procurement and engineering teams use every day. You’re done when it drives revenue, not when it’s merged. Don’t wait for a PRD.

 

WHAT WE MEAN BY BUILDER

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles.

A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other to.
Wear the customer’s shoes. Ship fast, finish fully. Sweat the details. Get 1% better every week. No lone wolves. Use AI as leverage, not a crutch.

- You’ve built AI features into a product, or you’re obsessively learning how.

- You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

 

STACK

Python, FastAPI, Postgres, and ClickHouse on the backend. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Storybook on the frontend. GitHub, Linear, and Figma for everything around it. For AI, whatever ships fastest.

 

HOW WE WORK

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes, not hours. Trust is high and feedback is direct.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity. 26 + 4 vacation days, Wellpass fitness membership, JobRad bike leasing, company pension plan, and a childcare (Kita) subsidy.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

title: Software Engineer, New Grad - Query Engines
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption.
 
You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date.
 
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build, and you will learn how to deliver all three.
 
Join us if you want to learn how modern data systems work from the inside and apply that knowledge to consequential problems.

Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at Life at Palantir and note that our offerings may vary by region.
 
In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the city and or country in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.
 
If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. We are committed to making the application and hiring process accessible to everyone and will provide a reasonable accommodation for those living with a disability. If you need an accommodation for the application or hiring process, please reach out and let us know how we can help.
 
Please note that you will never be asked to submit a payment or share financial information to participate in our interview process. If you suspect that you've been contacted by a scammer, we recommend you cease all communication with the individual and consider reporting them to the relevant authorities, such as the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

Your expertise will drive growth and innovation, positioning us at the forefront of the fleet insurance industry. - Experience in dealing with large corporate customers
